class.name: GroundStreamers3D
class.brief_description: Sand blowing over dry ground: the saltating grains as particles.
class.description: When the wind over a [GroundSurface3D] passes Bagnold's threshold (about 6 m/s at 10 m), grains leave dry sand and hop downwind in a layer a few centimetres deep: GPU particles in a square of [member extent] round the camera (or [member follow_target]), traced by the path tracer like any particles. The amount follows the same saltation flux as the surface's wind ripples ([member GroundSurface3D.wind_ripples]): the sand in the air is the flux over the grains' speed, and each particle stands for as many grains as that needs, drawn with their summed cross-section, so the sheet is as dense to the eye as the real one. Hop heights are exponential with a 4 cm mean and a hop runs about 11 times its height. Near the threshold the sand moves in streamers, ribbons about 20 cm wide and a few metres long carried downwind by the gusts, merging into a continuous sheet at twice the threshold friction speed. Damp sand, litter, soil and rock give the wind nothing (the surface's [code]blown[/code] share, see [method GroundSurface3D.get_material_at]).

method.name: airborne_mass
method.description: The mass of sand in the air over a square metre, kg, for a saltation flux of [param flux] kg/m/s.

method.name: get_active_ratio
method.description: The share of [member max_grains] flying this frame.

method.name: get_coverage
method.description: The share of the ground under streamers this frame: [code]1.0[/code] is a continuous sheet.

method.name: get_flux
method.description: The saltation flux this frame, kg per metre across the wind per second, times [member strength]. [code]0.0[/code] under the threshold.

method.name: get_grains_per_particle
method.description: How many real grains each particle stands for this frame.

method.name: get_wind
method.description: The 10 m wind speed over the surface this frame, m/s.

method.name: grain_speed
method.description: The mean speed of saltating grains, m/s (at the top of a mean hop).

method.name: streamer_coverage
method.description: The share of the ground under streamers at a [param friction_speed] (m/s): none under the threshold, 15% at it, a continuous sheet at twice it.

members.member: Width of the square round the follow point the grains fly in, m.
The node the square follows. Empty: the camera.
The grains' diameter, mm (fine sand is 0.1 to 0.3).
The [GroundSurface3D] the grains leave and land on. Empty: the active one.
Particles in the square. Each stands for many grains; more particles make a finer, smoother sheet for the same amount of sand.
The exposure the grains' streaks show, s.
